traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Dennstaedtiaceae: terrestrial ferns, mostly on creeping rhizomes with jointed hairs and no scales; leaves small to large and much divided, the stalks often with buds; sori at or just inside the margin, the indusium a line, a cup, or the margin turned back over the sorus.

traits.stipe_scales.note: Flora of North America (vol. 2), Dennstaedtiaceae: "Petiole ... hairy or glabrous", stems "bearing hairs (or less often scales)"; Pteridium: stem "scales absent", "Petiole glabrous to short-hairy". Read as absent.
